about.en: FEG (Feed Every Gorilla) is the token of the FEG ecosystem, a community DeFi project offering the SmartDeFi token launchpad, a decentralized exchange and holder rewards. This record is the current FEG token at 0xf3c7cecf8cbc3066f9a87b310cebe198d00479ac, deployed at the same address on BNB Smart Chain and Ethereum; it replaced the project's earlier FEG contracts, which are different tokens.
